spans.s: A cowherd, a milkman; मेरौ स्थिते दोग्धरि दोहदक्षे
A panegyrist, one who writes verses for hire or reward.
One who performs anything out of interested motives (with a view to profit himself).
दोग्ध्री [dōgdhrī], 1 A cow which yields milk.
A wet-nurse (having much milk; Mar. दाइ.)
A female who gives anything (with acc.).
